title: Newly Established Entertainment Center Equity Stake For Sale in Brea, USA
tagline: Newly established premium family entertainment center combining curated children’s play, specialty food and beverages, celebrations, and educational experiences. - Primarily serves families with children aged 6 months to 6 years, offering everyday play sessions, memberships, birthday parties, private events, and café experiences. - Generates revenue through individual admissions, recurring memberships, celebrations and private events, café sales, merchandise, and educational programming. - Opened its flagship location at a mall in December last year, following an investment of approximately $4.2 million in development and launch. - Combines premium children’s play facilities with an adult-friendly hospitality experience, creating multiple complementary revenue streams within one venue. - Has achieved approximately 45% repeat visitation, indicating early customer retention and opportunities to grow recurring membership revenue. - Currently developing additional revenue channels, including school and homeschool field trips, educational programs, business catering, space rentals, and brand activations. - Has an LOI with the lessor real estate group contemplating a potential 10-location rollout, subject to funding and definitive agreements. - The founding team brings a combination of corporate leadership, operational management, and hands-on experience in designing, developing, and operating the flagship location. - The business remains in its initial growth phase and is not yet EBITDA-positive. Management projects reaching EBITDA breakeven in spring next year. - Offers potential for expansion through additional locations, institutional partnerships, private events, educational programming, and corporate and brand collaborations. - Operations are supported by applicable municipal building and occupancy approvals, fire and life safety requirements, and food service permitting. We also hold a California ABC Type 41 license permitting the sale of beer and wine.
